description: Synthetic set for stage 5: answers one explicit relationship away from what a question matches — a Markdown link, a front-matter `reads`, a decision that supersedes another — whose passages share no word with the question, beside a two-section answer, direct hits, a hub rule, an unanswerable question, and a bridge only prose states, which no structural edge can find. An expectation `file#Heading` names one section; a bare file, any of its sections. Written inline so its pages never enter this wiki's own index or link checks.
